name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY)
description: State health assurance scheme providing cashless treatment in empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: NFSA and SFSS ration card holders and eligible Odisha residents.
benefits: Up to ₹5 lakh annual health coverage per family and higher coverage for women members.

name: KALIA Scheme
description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation for farmers and landless agricultural households.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers and landless agricultural households.
benefits: Financial support for cultivation, livelihood activities and insurance assistance.

name: CM-KISAN Yojana
description: Farmer income support scheme introduced by the Odisha Government.
benefits: Direct financial assistance to farmers in installments.

name: Mission Shakti
description: Flagship women empowerment programme through Self Help Groups (SHGs).
eligibility: Women Self Help Groups in Odisha.
benefits: Interest-free loans, livelihood support, training and market linkage.

name: Subhadra Yojana
description: Financial assistance scheme for eligible women in Odisha.
eligibility: Eligible women beneficiaries as notified by the Government.

name: Mamata Scheme
description: Conditional cash transfer programme for pregnant and lactating mothers.
eligibility: Pregnant and lactating women meeting scheme criteria.
benefits: Cash assistance for nutrition and maternal care.

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana
description: Pension scheme for elderly, widows, persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups.
eligibility: Senior citizens, widows and eligible persons with disabilities.

name: Mo Ghara Scheme
description: Housing assistance scheme for rural households not covered under PMAY.
eligibility: Eligible rural families without adequate housing.

name: Biju Pucca Ghar Yojana
description: Housing scheme for vulnerable rural households.
eligibility: Eligible rural families living in unsafe houses.
benefits: Financial assistance for pucca house construction.

name: Banishree Scholarship
description: Scholarship support for students with disabilities.
eligibility: Students with disabilities studying in recognized institutions.

name: Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakshyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA)
description: Support programme for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Assistive devices, rehabilitation and support services.

name: SAHAYA
description: Protection, care and rehabilitation support for destitute persons.

name: ABADANA
description: Welfare and protection scheme for senior citizens.

name: Sweekruti
description: Scheme for promotion of transgender equality and justice.

name: Nirman Shramik Kalyan Yojana
description: Welfare programme for registered construction workers.
benefits: Education assistance, maternity benefits, pension and insurance.
